info.label: Parcel ID
info.notes: A 16-character unique identifier for the parcel.

info.label: Property type
info.notes: Indicates whether the property is just a condemned property ("Condemned Property") or one where the owner could not be contacted ("Dead-End Property").

info.label: Latest inspection result
info.notes: The pass/fail result that the property received in its last inspection.

info.label: Inspection status
info.notes: This is either "Active" or "Inactive", to indicate whether the property is a subject of ongoing investigation. ("Inactive" records are now omitted.)
